newsitem.title: CANADA: Pembina successful in Serenpet bid.
newsitem.headline: Pembina successful in Serenpet bid.

text.p: Pembina Resources Ltd said on Friday it acquired 96 percent of Serenpet Inc's shares under its C$4.80-per-share cash takeover offer announced in November.
Pembina said it would acquire the remaining stock by exercising its right under the Canadian Business Corporations Act.

As a result of the compulsory acquisition, Serenpet will become a wholly owned subsidiary of private Pembina and its shares will be delisted on the Toronto Stock Exchange and American Stock Exchange, it said.
The deal was valued at about C$110 million. ((-- Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
